performance.verdict: Both channels dark 3 days; SOW blockers compound an already stalled funnel.

findings.text: Meta and Google both show $0 spend Sep 17–19 (3 consecutive days confirmed dark); all 117 28-day leads are Meta-sourced; Google delivered 0 conversions on $457.72 spend.
5 SOW milestones overdue (earliest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL gap closure, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unconfirmed complete.

CPL rose 33.79% to $16.77 in the last 7 days; 3-day signal (Sep 15–16 avg ~$13 CPL) vs prior 3 (Sep 12–14 ~$23 CPL blended) — darkout, not true efficiency decline, but trend cannot be trusted while spend is $0.
GHL shows 151 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and $0 pipeline value across 28 days — 117 ad leads entering but zero progressing, indicating a CRM intake or follow-up leak.
IG reach is 0 across all 45 series days; 28-day organic reach also 0 — IG is connected per SOW but has produced no impressions whatsoever.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta + Google spend today; confirm billing, payment method, and campaign status before any budget change.
suggestions.monday_update: Both Meta and Google registered $0 spend for Sep 17–19 (3 confirmed dark days), wiping all lead volume. Check ad account payment methods, billing thresholds, campaign pause status, and policy flags on both platforms today. Success is confirmed when both channels show non-zero spend on Sep 21 and leads resume within 48 hours. Re-check Sep 23.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 151 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — identify where contacts stall and confirm automation triggers fire correctly.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day GHL data shows 151 opportunities created with 0 won and 0 appointments booked — ad leads are entering but nothing is progressing, which is a CRM follow-up or automation failure, not an ads problem. Nacer/Ahmed to trace one live contact through each pipeline stage and confirm sequences are triggering. Success is at least one appointment booked within 7 days of ad leads resuming. Re-check Sep 27.

suggestions.text: Watch Google Ads efficiency: $457.72 spend, 0 conversions in 28 days — do not scale until pixel or call tracking is confirmed firing.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 0 conversions on $457.72 of 28-day spend; this is consistent with a known client-side pixel issue noted in the data rules. Do not increase Google budget or shift Meta dollars to Google until conversion tracking is verified end-to-end. Confirm pixel fires on at least 3 call events before next review. Re-check Sep 27.
